parsed.explanation: Recent organised targeting is documented, not tangential: Article 226 public-indecency is applied to gender expression and trans people are frequently accused, with at least 84 people, mainly gay men and trans women, arrested/prosecuted Sep 2024-Jan 2025 and a mass conviction of up to 4.5 years upheld on appeal in Feb 2025. Active sodomy enforcement is used as a police lever, with beatings and forced anal examinations as evidence, continuing after a 2017 pledge. Trans women in custody are processed by birth gender/former name systemically, with no visitor protection or effective remedy. Severity is imprisonment and custodial abuse; frequency and state involvement place this below ordinary elevated risk and near the severe-risk anchors, without documented executions.
